terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.article1Body: Wedillybird ("the Service") provides a SaaS wedding-planning platform offering guest management, WhatsApp invitations, RSVP tracking, check-in and shared photo galleries. These Terms of Service govern the use of the Service by anyone accessing it ("the User").
terms.article2Body: Use of the Service implies full and unconditional acceptance of these Terms. The User acknowledges having read and accepted them without reservation when creating their account.
terms.article3Body: Access to the Service requires creating an account by verifying a WhatsApp number. The User is responsible for the confidentiality of their number and for any action taken from their account. Any unauthorised use must be reported immediately.
terms.article4Body: The Service is offered with no free tier. For individuals planning a wedding, two one-shot plans are available: Essential (€19, core features + 30-day gallery) and Premium (€49, Essential + 6-month gallery + PDF album). A post-wedding upsell (+€29) extends the gallery to 5 years and adds the HD photo book. For professionals, monthly or annual subscriptions (Starter €89/month, Business €179/month, Agency €349/month, -20% annual) or pay-as-you-go (€69 per event). Payments are processed by Stripe (Europe) or CinetPay (West Africa). Full refund within 7 days if the event has not been sent. If the wedding is cancelled, free postponement to another date.
terms.article5Body: The User retains ownership of the content they upload. They grant Wedillybird a non-exclusive licence to use this content solely for the operation of the Service. Wedillybird retains ownership of the platform, its code and brand.
terms.article6Body: The Service is provided "as is". Wedillybird strives to ensure maximum availability but does not guarantee uninterrupted service. Wedillybird's liability is limited to the amount paid by the User over the past 12 months.
terms.article7Body: These Terms are governed by French law. Any dispute relating to their performance shall fall within the exclusive jurisdiction of the Paris courts, except for any contrary provision of public policy.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.controllerBody: Wedillybird, a platform operated by Tuum Agency, is the controller for the data collected through the Service.
privacy.dataCollectedBody: WhatsApp number (authentication), name and email (profile), information related to the weddings being organised (dates, venues, guest lists), photos shared in the gallery, technical logs (IP, user-agent).
privacy.purposesBody: Provide the Service, authenticate users, send invitations and notifications, process payments, prevent fraud, improve the platform.
privacy.legalBasisBody: Performance of the contract (account, payments, features), legitimate interest (security, abuse prevention), consent (non-essential cookies, marketing communications).
privacy.retentionBody: Account data: duration of the subscription + 3 years. Payment data: legal duration (10 years for invoicing). Technical logs: 12 months maximum.
privacy.subprocessorsBody: Convex (database, US), Vercel (hosting, US/EU), Stripe (payments, EU/US), Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (message delivery, EU/US), Amazon Rekognition Faces (temporary face indexing for photo search, EU). Data is minimised, never resold or shared with third parties for marketing. All bound by standard contractual clauses or equivalent mechanisms.
privacy.rightsBody: Access, rectification, erasure, objection, portability, restriction. To exercise a right, write to privacy@wedillybird.com. You can also file a complaint with the CNIL.
privacy.contactBody: Email: privacy@wedillybird.com. Reply within 30 days in line with the GDPR.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.whatBody: A cookie is a small text file stored on your device by a website. Wedillybird uses cookies that are essential to the operation of the Service.
cookies.typesBody: Session cookie (authentication, HMAC-signed, expires after 30 days of inactivity). Local IndexedDB storage (offline cache for check-in). No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are placed.
cookies.controlBody: You can delete cookies through your browser settings. Disabling the session cookie will sign you out of the Service.
cookies.thirdPartiesBody: Stripe sets its own cookies on its payment pages (outside the Wedillybird domain) for fraud prevention. See its privacy policy.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Wedillybird.

account.q: How do I create my account?
account.a: Click "Create an account", enter your WhatsApp number and type the 6-digit code received on WhatsApp. No password needed.

invitations.q: How do I send invitations to my guests?
invitations.a: Add your guests from the "Manage guests" page, then send them the personalised link Wedillybird generates for each one. Every guest gets a unique QR code for check-in.

rsvp.a: Your guests reply directly from their personalised link. You see responses arrive in real time on your dashboard, with the count of confirmed, declined and pending.

checkin.a: Yes. The check-in page caches the guest list locally. You can scan QR codes even without a connection; data syncs as soon as the connection comes back.

gallery.q: Can my guests add photos to the gallery?
gallery.a: Yes. From their invitation page, they can upload photos that go through your moderation before appearing in the shared gallery.

pricing.a: Two one-shot plans per wedding: Essential (€19) for WhatsApp invitations, RSVP, QR check-in and dashboard; Premium (€49) which adds a 6-month shared photo gallery and the final PDF album. A post-wedding upsell at +€29 lets you keep your gallery for 5 years with an HD photo book and high-definition export.

support.a: Write to support@wedillybird.com. Reply within 24 business hours.

guestVsInvitation.q: What's the difference between an invitation and a guest?
guestVsInvitation.a: An invitation = one entry in your list corresponding to a primary person (e.g. your cousin Aminata) to whom you send a personalised link with their QR code. That person can indicate in their reply that they will be coming with N additional people (for example their partner and children). The plan quota counts the number of invitations sent, not the total number of people attending. So with the Sérénité plan (150 invitations), you can welcome far more than 150 actual people on the day.

hero.title: A wedding lives in the conversation.
hero.subtitle: Your guests are already on WhatsApp. Wedillybird orchestrates everything there — the invitation, the RSVP, the day itself and the memories. Discreetly, until the next wedding.

manifesto.title: A wedding is no longer planned in a PDF.
manifesto.lede: You've probably received an invitation by email. You opened it once, maybe. Printed it? Never. Meanwhile, your guests are texting each other on WhatsApp to confirm they're coming, ask for the address, share their photos. That's where a wedding lives today — in the conversation. That's where it should be organised.

before.label: Yesterday
before.body: An overflowing inbox, a shared spreadsheet that goes out of sync, WhatsApp follow-ups to 47 people that eat up an entire afternoon. The constant doubt: "did Grandma actually get it?"

after.label: Today
after.body: A single personalised link per guest, opened the moment it lands, RSVP confirmed in 30 seconds. You watch replies come in without chasing anyone. On the day itself, offline check-in keeps working even when the château's WiFi gives up.

manifesto.pullquote: Six months after the wedding, your guests are still flipping through the photos. That's what Wedillybird gives you — not an app, a moment that lasts.
manifesto.source: Measured across the first 1,240 weddings celebrated with Wedillybird, 2026.

faq.q1Body: Yes, at any time. Pro-rata is calculated automatically.
faq.q2: What happens if I exceed my WhatsApp quota?
faq.q2Body: Beyond the included quota, +€0.06 per message sent, billed at the end of the month.
faq.q3Body: Yes, the annual total is equivalent to 12 months × 0.80. No hidden fees.

whyWhatsapp.q: Why WhatsApp instead of an email or a dedicated app?
whyWhatsapp.a: Because your guests are already there. WhatsApp shows a 98% open rate vs 22% for email, and requires no installation. It's the most universal channel internationally.

olderGuests.q: Will my older or less tech-savvy guests manage?
olderGuests.a: Yes. The invitation page opens in the WhatsApp browser in one tap — no app, no account to create. RSVP takes 3 buttons. More than 92% of grandparents tested confirmed without help.

guestLimit.q: What's the maximum number of guests?
guestLimit.a: No technical limit. The Essential and Premium plans include up to 500 invitations per wedding. Beyond that (weddings of 600+ guests), reach out — we'll adapt.

cancellation.q: What if we have to cancel or postpone the wedding?
cancellation.a: Free cancellation within 7 days of purchase. Beyond that, in case of cancellation, postponement of your event is free (up to 24 months). We've seen 2020 — your peace of mind comes first.

afterEvent.q: What do we keep after the wedding?
afterEvent.a: With Premium: moderated gallery for 6 months + final PDF album. With the post-wedding upsell at €29: we extend the gallery to 5 years, print an HD photo book and deliver a high-definition ZIP of every photo.

africa3g.q: How does it work without stable 4G?
africa3g.a: Day-of check-in works 100% offline (encrypted local IndexedDB cache). The gallery compresses photos before upload. The invitation page weighs less than 80 KB — tested on 3G with a 2-second load.

branding.q: Can the invitation design be customised?
branding.a: Yes. Primary and accent colours, cover photo, typefaces, intro text. For pro wedding planners, agency branding (logo, colours, subdomain) is included in the Business plan.

data.q: What do you do with my guests' data?
data.a: Stored in Europe (Convex Frankfurt, Vercel Paris), encrypted at rest. No sharing with third parties, no advertising. Full deletion on request, in line with the GDPR. Details in our privacy policy.
